description:
Materializer placement always picks the first capable node: find_materializer_capable_node (materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex:373-377) returns hd(node_capabilities[:materializer]), so every shard's materializer piles onto one node. Rotate/spread placement (round-robin or load-aware), matching the round-robin already used in commit_proxy_startup_phase.ex and log_recruitment_phase.ex.

Rescoped 2026-08-15: the original thundering-herd half (N :noproc DOWNs -> N uncapped concurrent recruitments, from the PR #99 gating audit) is stale — after bedrock-qzr.8/qzr.9 (dfd15d02, 7b57281f) node loss stops the director and recruitment is a sequential reduce_while inside recovery, so no concurrency cap is needed. Only the placement-spreading ask remains.
title: Materializer placement always picks first capable node; spread round-robin
